title: Performance matched discretionary accrual measures
sources_checked: PROC CONTENTS source catalog, local catalog: COMP.FUNDA (941,340 rows; 949 variables; update 2026-07-22), fields GVKEY/DATADATE/FYEAR/INDFMT/CONSOL/POPSRC/DATAFMT/CURCD/FIC/PDATE/ACT/CHE/LCT/DLC/DP/AT/SALE/RECT/PPENT/NI/CEQ/MKVALT/OANCF/PRCC_F/CSHO/SICH. Read-only stream over all rows; standard INDL/C/D/STD filter found FY2000–FY2004 observations and 10,901 FY2004 filtered rows, with DATADATE through 2005-05-31.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog, local catalog: COMP.CO_INDUSTRY (372,563 rows; 8 variables; update 2026-08-14), fields GVKEY/DATADATE/YEAR/CONSOL/POPSRC/SICH. Read-only stream found 8,780 valid-SIC rows with YEAR=2004 and dated records through 2005-12-31.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog, local catalog: CRSP.MSF (5,153,763 rows; 21 variables; update 2025-12-05), fields DATE/PERMNO/PERMCO/PRC/SHROUT. Read-only stream found 83,607 monthly rows in calendar 2004 and source dates through 2005-12-30.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog, local catalog: CRSP.STOCKNAMES (83,280 rows; 16 variables; update 2025-12-05), fields PERMNO/PERMCO/NAMEDT/NAMEENDDT/SHRCD/SICCD. Dated effective-name checks found 7,942 records effective in 2004 and 7,873 effective in 2005.

PROC CONTENTS source catalog, local catalog: CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE (92,711 rows; 9 variables; update 2026-08-14), fields GVKEY/LINKPRIM/LINKTYPE/LPERMNO/LPERMCO/LINKDT/LINKENDDT. Dated check found 4,108 LC links with primary markers P/C effective in 2004.

Bounded duplicate audit of current COMP.FUNDA after the accepted INDL/C/D/STD filters: 342,559 FY1962–FY2004 rows; two repeated GVKEY/FYEAR groups (1982 and 1983); zero repeated keys in FY2000–FY2004; zero tied top-DATADATE/top-PDATE groups.

Accepted sample/model records and predecessor execution checked: output/samples/records/W3124170598.json; output/models/records/W3124170598.json; output/reproductions/packages/W3124170598/attempt_02/outcome.json and tables/table1_panel_a.csv.
changes: Extended the accepted observation clock from fiscal years 1963–1999 to the requested pooled 1963–2004 horizon. FY1962 remains available only for exact one-year lag construction; DATADATE remains a separate source-reporting-date clock.

Rebuilt the historical and added years together from current local COMP.FUNDA, COMP.CO_INDUSTRY, CRSP.MSF, CRSP.STOCKNAMES, and CCMXPF_LINKTABLE inputs. The latest selected FY2004 DATADATE is 2005-05-31; 974 supported FY2004 rows have reporting dates in calendar 2005 and retain FYEAR=2004.

Preserved the accepted six annual SIC2-by-FYEAR OLS specifications, complete-case rules, ten-observation minimum, full-rank check, performance-match construction, and Table 1 Panel A pipeline. Updated only time bounds/boundary audits and the submission sample description.

Added native e(sample)-based original-period and added-period counts within each model-specific full-rank OLS group fit. Each EXT_SAMPLE line records firm-year counts and the computed last contributing fiscal year.
limitations: The article describes annual cross-sectional regressions but does not name an estimator; OLS via accepted asreg fits with native Stata rank checks remains a documented best-effort estimator. The article specifies excluding groups below ten observations, while the frozen extraction records a conflicting minimum-eight criterion; the accepted build retains the paper text’s ten-observation rule.

The article does not fully specify all Table 1 characteristic formulas/timing, winsorization grouping, performance-match replacement, or exact tie rules. The inherited code retains its documented best-effort choices. Modified-Jones DAR scaling is implemented as change in receivables over lagged assets, consistent with the inherited construction and noted source ambiguity.

The inherited MVE construction uses dated CRSP common-share values when eligible and PRCC_F×CSHO as a guarded Compustat fallback for domestic USD rows. The fallback price currency is inferred. In the extended common Table 1 sample, fallback and direct CRSP values all contribute; this limitation continues.

The inherited historical OCF proxy is NI minus the constructed accrual amount when OANCF is missing; the paper does not identify an exact Compustat cash-flow mnemonic. OANCF is present for the added-period final-table rows.

The accepted original-period Table 1 reproduction had 124,351 common rows versus 122,798 reported in the paper. The pooled extended common sample has 150,084 rows, including 25,733 FY2000–FY2004 rows. No sample tuning was applied; inherited field/timing and matching choices remain possible sources of the published-count and moment differences.

Original and extended coefficient vectors were not stored by the accepted predecessor. Like-for-like focal comparisons therefore use the saved Table 1 Panel A fitted-residual mean and standard deviation, in percentage of assets, rather than regression coefficients.
